subject: gk
question: Orders and other instruments made and executed in the name of the President are to be authenticated:

options.text: in such manner as may be specified in rules made by the President

solution:
The correct answer is** **__**in such manner as may be specified in rules made by the President.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 77 of the Indian Constitution** regulates how the government conducts itself. 
 
• The following provisions are mentioned:

 
• **The President's name must** be used in all executive actions taken by the Indian government.
 
• **Orders and other documents **prepared and executed in the President's name must be authenticated in accordance with any rules the President may make, and the** legality of a document **that has been properly authenticated cannot be contested on the grounds that it was not created or **executed by the President.**
 
• **The President shall establish guidelines** for the more convenient conduct of Government of India business, as well as for the distribution of said **business among Ministers.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** is responsible for upholding the order, which is established by the** President of India **through the **President's Secretariat. **The daily operations of the **Indian government** are not covered by it.
 
• A **candidate who meets the requirements** to serve as a Supreme Court judge will be chosen by the President to serve as India's **attorney general.**
 
• 
 
There are **two types of executives** in our country. These are the Political Executive and the **Permanent Executive. **
